purpose: R22b#8: formal paired-arm tests for the E9b/E9c pipeline-vs-linear gaps (10-seed caliber), requested by the stats-protocol commitment in manuscript section 4.2
tests: one-sample t-test and Wilcoxon signed-rank of arm-(b) per-seed top-1 against the deterministic arm-(a) linear value; arm (a) is deterministic given the fixed seed-42 stratified subset, so the pairing is b-seed vs the single (a) value
family_note: Family = the two E9b/E9c gap tests reported here (m=2); a Holm step-down within this family keeps both qualitative readings unchanged (NTU120 both tests pass at m=1 and m=2 thresholds; UCF101 passes neither at corrected thresholds). The E9d PanAf gap (+1.2pp, 5/10 wins) is not tested here because its b-arm distribution spans ties with the linear arm at near-chance separation on a long-tailed 9-class space; reported as directional only, per the manuscript.

E9b_NTU120.reading: the semantic pipeline's margin over a budget-restricted linear head is statistically robust at the 10-seed caliber

one_sample_t.note: nominally below 0.05 but does not survive any within-family correction

E9c_UCF101.reading: direction-consistent but not statistically significant under either test; the manuscript must not claim a significant pipeline advantage on this tier

driver_note: computed inline via scipy.stats during the R22 audit window; deterministic given the input JSONs
